scope: 29 repositories owned by asukamiyachi, latest default branches, including private repositories and one fork; six accessible external-owner collaboration repositories excluded
metric: sum of Git blob sizes for recognized source-code and style/data extensions (estimated; not GitHub Linguist)
method: Use file extensions and selected special filenames, exclude common dependency directories, known generated-code patterns and build output directories, and omit documentation, binary assets and lockfiles. Source files containing embedded data are counted unless excluded by path/filename rules.
caution: The tallied JavaScript includes two unusually large files (src/wav.js and server/mext-data.mjs) that may embed data. This chart is the unadjusted 29-owned-repository scenario; the file-based metric does not measure authorship, skill, lines of code, or original logic. Folder/filename heuristics are incomplete and may still include generated content.
